Installed [`ui-ux-pro-max-skill`](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill.git) into the project's [`.agents/skills/`](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/) directory.

### Installed Skills

* [**`ui-ux-pro-max`**](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md) — Main orchestrator skill with searchable local design intelligence (styles, color palettes, font pairings, chart recommendations, UX guidelines, and stack guides).
* [**`design-system`**](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/design-system/SKILL.md) — Design token architecture, component specs, and slide generation.
* [**`ui-styling`**](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/ui-styling/SKILL.md) — Tailwind CSS utility generation and shadcn component integrations.
* [**`design`**](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/design/SKILL.md) — Visual design, logo color psychology, CIP guidelines, and social assets.
* [**`brand`**](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/brand/SKILL.md) — Brand guidelines, asset consistency, and token sync.
* [**`banner-design`**](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/banner-design/SKILL.md) — Standard display banner formats and styling rules.
* [**`slides`**](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/slides/SKILL.md) — Presentation deck structure and copywriting frameworks.

### Verification

The search engine at [`search.py`](https://github.com/maziyazamikhaya222-alt/first-project/blob/main/.agents/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py) has been tested and verified:

```bash
python3 .agents/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "<product_type> <keywords>" --design-system
```

All changes are saved and committed to your repository.
